stem:
Picornaviruses are small viruses that are $30\text{nm}$ in diameter. Picornaviruses are able to enter the cells of mammals and birds and can replicate within these cells.

Fig. 1.1 shows the entry of a picornavirus into its host cell.

{{figure:figure_1_1.webp}}

parts.text: State the key features of a virus, such as picornavirus.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: With reference to Fig. 1.1, describe how the picornavirus enters the host cell.
